_comment: SRW3 Phase 1X — the PINNED expected ghost-claim inventory. Independently maintained: each label list below was derived by extracting every 'label(...)' token from the COMMITTED claim-specification artifact named in 'artifact' (derivation command recorded per suite in phase1x/claims/INVENTORY-DERIVATION.md, at Phase 1X base commit 34ef2321f2875682bd03adf7eb5f601e256cf7ad). It is NOT copied from split_ghost_claims.py / split_gen_claims.py runtime output and NOT inferred from any ledger row count. The runner (phase1x/proofs/run_1x_ghost.sh) asserts the splitter output equals THIS list before invoking K; the gate (phase1x/scripts/summarize_1x.py) asserts the verdict ledger equals THIS set. Changing a list requires a reviewed commit on a phase branch (append-only history).
_status_vocabulary: PROVED (rc=0 + >=1 '#Top' + no prover [Error] + no WarnStuckClaimState) | FAILED-STUCK (rc=1 + WarnStuckClaimState + 'backend terminated' prover error) | FAILED (rc=1 without the stuck signature) | TIMEOUT (rc=124) | NOT RUN (no execution result) | BLOCKED (environment unavailable). Evidence rules: phase1x/report §B; the observed status is the PROVER outcome; 'role' records the claim's design intent orthogonally (a designed negative may legitimately present the stuck signature; it must NEVER present rc=0).

role.GH-T: designed minimal-destination probe of the forall-n theorem (register R5); must never close (rc=0) without a reviewed statement change
role.GH-T2-NEG: designed non-vacuity control (the T2 form must NOT be provable without its side condition)

extra_rows.role: the audit_ghost_exact.py byte-faithfulness certificate row (not a splitter label)

role.GH2-NEG: designed negative control (alias violation must not close)

role.GH3-NEG: designed negative control (authority violation must not close)

role.GH4-NEG: designed negative control (multi-write violation must not close)

gen_full._note: gen_full deliberately has NO A1 claim: the committed artifact contains 11 labels while cm2_alias/cm3_auth contain 12. This asymmetry is pinned here (a splitter or artifact change in either direction is a REJECTION, not a silent acceptance).

ledger_arithmetic.note: 12 (main) + 12 (cm2_alias) + 12 (cm3_auth) + 11 (gen_full) = 47 claims + 1 fidelity certificate row = 48 ledger rows. The count is DERIVED from this inventory (sum of the label lists + extra_rows), never accepted as a free-standing shared set.
